Title: FlowDesk - Freelance Operations Platform
Description: Shipped FlowDesk - a freelance operations SPA: Kanban projects, client management, invoices and hand-rolled SVG charts. Zero frameworks, pure HTML/CSS/JS, live on GitHub Pages.

Title: Aurora - AI SaaS Landing Page
Description: Just shipped Aurora - a high-converting AI SaaS landing page with dark glassmorphism, animated gradient orbs and scroll-triggered reveals. Zero frameworks, pure HTML/CSS/JS.

Title: Pulse - Pomodoro Focus Timer
Description: Shipped Pulse - a premium dark-mode pomodoro timer with a glowing gradient progress ring, automatic break cues and session streak tracking. Zero frameworks, pure HTML/CSS/JS.

Title: Coinly - a personal expense tracker that makes your money make sense
Description: Coinly is a personal expense tracker that turns raw spending into instant insight with an animated donut chart, glowing category bars and live monthly trends. Users log expenses in seconds, track budgets by category, and export everything to CSV. Built with React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.

Title: Tierly - Premium Pricing Page
Description: A dark premium pricing page with three glassmorphism plan cards and an animated monthly/yearly billing toggle that re-prices every plan in real time. Gradient headline, aurora glow and a save-20% pill make the upgrade feel irresistible. Built with pure HTML, CSS and JavaScript - no frameworks.

Title: Applywise - Job Application Tracker
Description: A kanban job application tracker built with vanilla JavaScript. Drag roles from Applied to Interview to Offer, log every follow-up, and see your response rate at a glance. All data persists locally in the browser.

Title: Divvy - Trip Expense Splitter
Description: A trip expense splitter built with vanilla JavaScript. Add travellers, log what each person paid, and it calculates the fewest transfers needed to settle everyone up. Data persists locally in the browser.

Title: Spendly - Premium Expense & Budget Tracker
Description: Spendly is a premium dark-mode expense tracker that makes budgeting feel calm instead of stressful. Log spending in two taps, watch your budget ring fill in real time, and see exactly which category is quietly eating your wallet. It runs entirely in the browser with zero backend, so your financial data never leaves your device.

Title: Wanderly - Day-by-day travel itinerary planner with a live budget ring
Description: Wanderly is a premium dark-mode travel itinerary planner built with vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Add stops to each day, watch a live budget ring react in real time, and stage curated destination picks into the plan. No frameworks, no backend, no build step.

Title: Kanbanly - Premium Drag & Drop Task Board
Description: Kanbanly is a premium dark glassmorphism kanban board that runs entirely in the browser. Drag tasks across Backlog, In Progress and Done columns while a live progress bar tracks your momentum. No account, no backend, and your board persists locally.

Title: Formly - Premium Drag & Drop Form Builder
Description: Formly is a premium dark-mode form builder that runs entirely in the browser. Drag fields onto a live canvas, publish a shareable hosted link, and watch responses land in an animated dashboard with response rates and CSV export. No frameworks, no backend, no build step.

Title: Testimly - Collect Client Testimonials into a Wall of Love
Description: Testimly is a dark-mode testimonial collector that turns happy clients into social proof. Send one link, collect ratings and short quotes, and render them into a beautiful embeddable Wall of Love. It runs fully in the browser with local storage and zero setup.

Title: Estately - Premium Real Estate Listings
Description: Estately is a clean real-estate listings app with instant filtering by city, budget and beds, sortable results, and a browser-saved shortlist. Built as a polished, agent-ready dark-mode front-end demo with glass cards and zero setup.

Title: Outfitly - Wardrobe & Outfit Planner
Description: Outfitly is a stylish wardrobe and outfit planner that lets you catalog your clothes, build looks in seconds, and plan the week ahead. It filters instantly by category or season and saves everything locally in the browser with zero setup.

Title: Ambiently - Premium Focus Sound Mixer
Description: Ambiently is a premium browser-based focus sound mixer that blends six living ambiences - rain, ocean, fire, wind, night and cafe - into one seamless mix. Every sound is synthesised in real time with the Web Audio API, so there are no audio files or downloads. It pairs smooth volume faders and four one-tap presets with an animated equaliser inside a dark glassmorphism interface.

Title: Vitalsly - Premium Fitness & Workout Tracker
Description: Vitalsly is a premium dark fitness dashboard for logging workouts and building training streaks. It features an animated daily-goal progress ring, a live 7-day activity chart, automatic calorie estimates and weekly goal meters. Sessions persist locally in the browser with vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

Title: Recallio - Premium Flashcards & Spaced Repetition
Description: A premium flashcards and spaced-repetition study app. Flip 3D cards, rate your recall, and track retention, streaks and due cards in a sleek dark dashboard. Built with vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

Title: Seatly - Restaurant Reservation & Table Booking System
Description: Seatly is a restaurant reservation platform with live table availability, an interactive floor-plan picker and instant booking confirmation. The owner dashboard keeps waitlist, covers and peak-hour stats in one view. Built as a polished dark-mode front-end demo with glassmorphism cards and zero setup.

Title: Postwave - Plan, Preview & Schedule Social Media Posts
Description: Postwave is a social media planner that turns scattered post ideas into a steady publishing rhythm for creators and small agencies. It combines a drag-and-drop weekly calendar, platform preview mockups, a smart publish queue and a live best-time-to-post heatmap. Built as a polished dark-mode single-file demo with zero setup.

Title: Upvibe - Collect Feature Requests & Share a Public Roadmap
Description: Upvibe is a customer feedback board that turns scattered feature requests into a public roadmap users can actually follow. Customers post ideas and upvote what matters while you triage everything on a drag-and-drop status board and close the loop with a live changelog. Built as a polished dark-mode single-file demo with zero setup.

Title: SigMint - Build a Stunning HTML Email Signature in Minutes
Description: SigMint is a browser tool that turns your name, links and photo into a professional HTML email signature in minutes. Pick a template, customize colors, social icons and a call-to-action button, then copy clean HTML that pastes straight into Gmail, Outlook or Apple Mail. Built as a polished dark-mode single-file demo with zero setup.

Title: Moodiary - A Cozy Mood Journal That Reveals Your Patterns
Description: Moodiary is a cozy daily journal that pairs two-tap mood check-ins with gentle writing prompts. Track your moods on a color-coded calendar, spot patterns over time and keep a private gratitude list - everything stored locally in the browser. Built as a polished dark-mode single-file demo with zero setup.

Title: Flipdeck - A Spaced-Repetition Flashcard App That Makes Studying Stick
Description: A spaced-repetition flashcard app for focused studying - create decks in seconds, review with smooth 3D card flips, and let the SM-2 algorithm resurface cards right before you forget them. Includes streaks, deck stats, a focus mode and offline-first storage in a dark study-cockpit UI.

Title: Leasely - Rent, Leases and Maintenance for Small Landlords
Description: Leasely is a dashboard for small landlords to track rent payments, lease renewals and maintenance requests in one place. Tenants get a simple portal to report issues with photos and follow the repair status. Built as a polished dark-mode single-file demo with zero setup.

Title: Crewly - Call Sheets and Crew Booking for Small Video Production Teams
Description: Crewly is a call sheet builder for small video production teams. Build a shoot schedule in minutes, collect crew availability from one link and keep gear checklists, locations and weather in sync. Built as a polished dark-mode single-file demo with zero setup.

Title: Hooklab - Real-Time Webhook Inspector
Description: A real-time webhook inspector for developers. Each endpoint captures incoming requests with headers, payload and signature checks, then lets you replay them in one click. Built to make third-party integrations like Stripe, Shopify and GitHub painless to debug.

Title: Starplot - Stargazing Planner
Description: A stargazing planner that scores the next seven nights for viewing quality. It combines moon phase, cloud cover, light pollution and location data, then shows which planets, constellations and meteor showers are visible. Includes saved dark-sky spots and a personal observation log.

Title: Inkdesk - A Booking and Deposit System Built for Tattoo Studios
Description: A booking and deposit system for tattoo studios. Artists publish flash slots, clients pay a deposit to lock a chair, and every booking arrives with a signed consent form and reference photos. The front desk gets one daily view of sessions, deposit status, aftercare reminders and healing check-ins.

Title: Batchly - A Brewery Batch Tracker That Keeps Every Fermentation on Schedule
Description: A batch tracker for small breweries and homebrewers. Log original and final gravity to get ABV, attenuation and cost per litre, watch the fermentation curve, and get reminders for dry-hopping and cold-crashing. Prints a clean batch sheet for the taproom or distributor.

Title: Buildlog - A Site Diary That Turns Jobsite Photos Into Client-Ready Progress Reports
Description: Buildlog is a mobile-first site diary for contractors and small construction crews. It turns daily jobsite photos and notes into dated, client-ready progress reports, and keeps delays and change orders documented. Owners get a clean share link instead of a messy camera roll.

Title: Kilnly - A Kiln Firing and Glaze Journal for Pottery Studios
Description: Kilnly is a firing schedule and glaze journal built for pottery studios and independent ceramicists. Potters log cone, ramp, soak and cool-down, see a visual firing curve, and scale glaze recipes by batch weight. Each finished piece stays linked to the exact firing and glaze combo behind it.

Title: Corkly - A Wine Cellar and Tasting Journal for Collectors
Description: A wine cellar and tasting journal that keeps every bottle, vintage and rating in one searchable place. Snap a label, log structured tasting notes, and see each bottle drink window at a glance. Built for collectors, wine bars and sommeliers.

Title: Stablely - A Barn and Horse Care Manager for Equestrian Yards
Description: A barn management app that gives every horse one record for feed plans, farrier and vet dates, medication and turnout notes. Recurring care reminders fire before appointments, and staff log rides or health checks from their phone. Owners get a weekly summary without a phone call.
